lines.text: Zophar the Naamathite replies and says the triumph of the wicked has been brief since man was placed on the earth.
Though the wicked man's head touches the clouds, he will fly away like a dream and never be found.
The wicked man's sons will seek the favor of the poor, and his food will sour into the venom of lions.
He has oppressed and forsaken the poor, so God will vent His fury upon him as he eats.
Though he flees from an iron weapon, a silver-tipped arrow will pierce him, and fire will devour what is left in his tent.
